documentation.D: Vault difficulty multiplier: (1 + sigil difficulty from sigils/definitions.json) x (1 + medallion objectiveDifficultyBonus / 100). x = D - 1 is the '+x Difficulty' a player sees
documentation.exponents: requirement = base x D^exponent, per objective. 1 = linear, 0.5 = square root
documentation.bingoTileClasses: Exponent per bingo tile class; bingoTileClassByName maps a tile's renderer name to a class, unlisted tiles are linear
documentation.stack*: Challenge stacks from D: stackLinearFactor x D below stackBreakpoint, else stackOffset + D^stackPower; a vault with D <= 1 gets none
documentation.crateTiersBySigilDifficulty: crate_tier stacks by sigil difficulty (not D): highest key not above the sigil's difficulty applies
documentation.scavengerGoalFloor*: Minimum scavenger goal count by x, below and from scavengerGoalFloorHighLevelFrom; a higher roll is kept
documentation.ballisticGridBonus: Extra ballistic bingo rows and columns by x, capped at ballisticGridCap
documentation.survivalReservedWaveGroups: Survival starts at wave group floor(x), but never later than size minus this many groups
